responsibility: This GCC-private shim prepares the VxWorks/Dinkumware yvals configuration for use with G++ on supported VxWorks environments. It conditionally includes the target system’s yvals.h for VxWorks 7 or RTP builds, then overrides Dinkumware feature-selection macros like _HAS_CPP11, _HAS_CPP14, and _HAS_CPP17 to disable assumptions tied to Dinkumware intrinsics that are incompatible with GCC’s C++ compilation model. It serves as the policy layer consumed by the other VxWorks wrapper headers before including affected standard headers.
